name: Solenne Voidpetal Genewear Couture Night Drape
description: A Tier 5 VIP lounge piece from Solenne's experimental Genewear Couture line — a full-length asymmetric drape gown built around the body's geneware modifications rather than despite them. The primary fabric is Solenne's proprietary Voidpetal — a ultra-thin, gravity-weighted material that flows like liquid shadow, appearing pure matte black at rest but blooming with deep bioluminescent indigo and pearl under UV and sound-reactive lighting, the patterns shifting organically as the fabric moves. The gown opens at the upper back in a structured architectural frame — twin arcing panels of boned holographic organza that spread away from the spine like abstract wings, designed to accommodate geneware wings or simply to stand alone as sculpture. A full-length tail split runs the left side seam, edged in matching Voidpetal with a trailing hem that sweeps the floor. Horn channels at the crown are integrated into a matching headpiece — a minimal arc of the same holographic organza with fiber-optic threading that responds to the wearer's bioluminescent skin by mirroring its color in the headpiece's light output. Footwear is barefoot-compatible with optional Solenne Voidpetal ankle wraps that trail to the floor.
functionality: Sound-reactive and UV-reactive Voidpetal requires no power source — purely material-reactive. Geneware wing accommodation frame is adjustable via concealed internal boning for wingspan up to 1.8 meters. Tail split is fully unbound for unrestricted movement of any tail type. Headpiece fiber-optic response to bioluminescent skin is passive — proximity-reactive, no BCI required. Barefoot-compatible base allows geneware foot modifications.
what_it_says: This is someone for whom the entire room is a backdrop. The gown doesn't perform for the club — the club performs for the gown. Geneware is not accommodated here; it is celebrated as the design's reason for existing. Tier 5 doesn't explain itself. It simply arrives and the lighting adjusts.
worn_by: bioluminescent geneware individuals with significant social capital
manufacturer: Solenne — Tier 5 corponation fashion house, Spire district flagship
story_hooks: The Voidpetal fabric's organic bioluminescent bloom pattern has begun responding to a specific frequency that isn't music — it's a coded signal, and the gown is acting as an unintentional receiver, broadcasting the wearer's location to someone who should not know where they are.

A rival Tier 5 power broker's companion is wearing an identical gown — impossible, since each piece is custom commission — and the implications of who had access to Solenne's private pattern files are deeply dangerous.

The headpiece's fiber-optic response activates in proximity to another bioluminescent individual in the VIP lounge — someone the wearer has never met but whose genetic signature their geneware is recognizing, which is impossible unless they share a designer.

physical_description.visual_profile: A dramatic, floor-length asymmetric gown that reads as pure architectural sculpture. The silhouette is deliberately body-responsive — designed to highlight rather than conceal geneware modifications. The upper back features twin arcing panels of holographic organza that spread like abstract wings or a cosmic halo, while the front drapes in liquid folds of matte black that pool at the feet. The overall impression is that of a living shadow caught mid-transformation.
physical_description.fit: Fitted through the torso with strategic compression at the geneware-sensitive upper back, flowing to completely unrestricted at the legs. The asymmetric left seam creates a full tail split, allowing movement while maintaining sculptural drama. Designed for the augmented body rather than standard human anatomy.
physical_description.primary_material: Proprietary Voidpetal™ — ultra-thin gravity-weighted synth-blend with light-reactive bioluminescent core. Holographic organza for structural panels. Fiber-optic threading throughout.
physical_description.texture: Primary gown is smooth and liquid-like, almost oily in its matte finish at rest. The back panels feature a subtle iridescent shimmer visible only under direct light. Organza sections are crisp and architectural, with micro-textured surface for light-diffusion. The trailing hem portions have a feathered, weightless quality.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant: pure matte black with zero reflectivity. Under UV/sound-reactive lighting: deep bioluminescent indigo blooms organically across the fabric in fractal patterns, accented by pearl-white ghosting. The back panels shift through holographic spectrum — cyan, magenta, silver — depending on light angle and wearer movement.
physical_description.closures: None visible — friction-fit design with integrated micro-adhesive strips along the upper back and shoulders. Headpiece attaches magnetically at crown integration points. Ankle wraps use Solenne signature magnetic snap closures.
distinctive_features: Twin arcing holographic organza wing-panels at upper back, specifically designed to frame and accommodate geneware wings or bio-augmentations
Horn-channel integration into matching arc headpiece with responsive fiber-optic threading
Full-length asymmetric tail split with floor-sweeping hem on left seam
Sound-reactive and UV-reactive bioluminescent patterning that shifts with wearer movement and ambient environment
Barefoot-compatible construction with optional matching ankle wraps that trail to floor
Integrated geneware accommodation without visible reinforcement — the garment *expects* augmentation
Microscopic Solenne house mark embedded in the fiber-optic threading of headpiece
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — but Tier 5 exclusive. This piece costs more than most people earn annually (est. 85,000+ Φ). Only available to verified VIP clientele in Solenne's Spire district flagship.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by the post-human elite — corpo executives with visible geneware modifications who refuse to hide them. The wearer is making a statement about augmentation as aesthetic and personal expression rather than functional necessity. This is haute couture for the genetically rewritten. Signifies membership in exclusive underground VIP spaces, experimental body-modification communities, and the absolute pinnacle of neo-noir fashion consciousness.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine — these pieces are hand-fitted during 4-6 week consultations and treated as wearable art. Most owners have them professionally cleaned after each wearing. The bioluminescent properties never fade. Aged pieces develop a subtle patina in the matte black, gaining prestige rather than appearing worn.

image_prompt: High-fashion neo-noir editorial photograph of the Solenne Voidpetal Genewear Couture Night Drape on an augmented model with visible bioluminescent skin and sculptural back modifications. The model is posed in profile-to-camera, shoulders back, allowing the twin holographic organza wing-panels to spread dramatically from the spine. The floor-length asymmetric drape pools like liquid shadow at the feet. Moody, dark studio lighting with strategic UV uplighting revealing the deep indigo and pearl bioluminescence blooming organically across the Voidpetal fabric. The back panels shimmer with holographic iridescence — cyan, magenta, silver. The fiber-optic threading in the arc headpiece mirrors the model's skin luminescence in real-time. Dark concrete backdrop, cool color temperature. The overall mood is otherworldly, post-human, and profoundly elegant. Emphasize the architectural wing-panels and the responsive light interplay between garment and wearer's augmentations. --ar 2:3 --v 6
